_comment: CIVILIAN kit: a faired INTAKE SCOOP - a hull-coloured stepped shell with a dark mouth and one amber-lit slot glowing inside it. The industrial answer to this class is a bolted grille; a ship built to be sold FAIRS the opening and lights it, so the only dark geometry is the mouth itself and the machinery behind it never shows. Long on Z so `align: Run` lays the scoop down the hull's flow line - detail on this kit travels LENGTHWISE.
